full_judgment: 4. Subsequently, the preemption application was amended incorporating the fact the heirs of Yukyb Ali Munshi had shown transfer in respect of an area of 3 kanis, 2, gonads, 2 karas and 2 krantees equivalent to 3.76 acres land out of the disputed C.S. Khatian Nos. 17, 18, 19, 20 and 21 along with Khas Khatian No.1 and the schedule to the sale deed had shown that 2.63 acres land was sold from C.S. Kharian No.17. The pre-emptee had no interest in the case holding, whereas the per-emptors were co-sharers by inheritance as will as by purchase and as such, they were entitled to preempt the case lands.
